* Assist junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance.

* Strong understanding of infrastructure monitoring and troubleshooting techniques.
* Familiarity with operating systems and network fundamentals related to infrastructure support.
* Ability to analyze and resolve issues in production and development environments.
* Good communication skills to interact effectively with users and technical teams.

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Elastic Stack (ELK).
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Tech Support Engineer
description:
At Vehere, we’re not just building cybersecurity products, we’re shaping the future of how organizations detect, understand, and respond to evolving cyber threats.
 



 As a Tech Support Engineer, you’ll be part of a high\-caliber team solving complex, real\-world security challenges. You’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful technology, collaborate with talented people across teams and geographies, and turn bold ideas into solutions that make a measurable impact.
 



 We’re looking for people who are curious, driven, and ready to challenge the status quo, people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and build things that matter.
 



 If you’re ready to push boundaries, solve problems that matter, and help shape the next generation of cybersecurity, we’d love to have you build the future with us.
 



**Job Summary:** 




 We are looking for a highly motivated and customer\-focused Customer Support \& Professional Services Engineer with strong expertise in Firewall, cybersecurity, and network infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for deploying, integrating, and supporting Vehere’s AI\-powered network security solutions across enterprise environments. You will work closely with customer SOC teams, network engineers, and internal product teams to ensure successful implementation, optimal performance, and rapid issue resolution.
 



**Key Roles and Responsibilities:** 



* Deliver end\-to\-end deployment and professional services for Vehere firewall solutions, including installation, configuration, integration, and optimization.
* Provide Level 1/Level 2 technical support to enterprise customers, ensuring timely resolution and excellent customer experience.
* Monitor firewall logs, security events, and traffic patterns to identify suspicious activities, security threats, performance bottlenecks, and policy violations.
* Perform firewall health checks, firmware upgrades, patch management, and security hardening activities to ensure optimal device performance and compliance.
* Collaborate with SOC, Network, and Security teams to investigate security alerts, support incident response activities, and strengthen network security posture.
* Troubleshoot complex firewall and network security issues by analyzing traffic flows, packet captures (PCAP), routing configurations, and firewall logs, escalating cases to Engineering when required.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for security incidents, network outages, and firewall\-related service disruptions, providing actionable recommendations and preventive measures.
* Support firewall migration, rule\-base review, policy optimization, and change management activities while minimizing business impact and ensuring compliance with security standards.
* Apply strong knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, Routing, Switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and cybersecurity principles to support secure and resilient network environments.
* Work with leading firewall technologies and security features such as Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), URL Filtering, Application Control, Anti\-Malware, and Threat Intelligence integrations.
* Adhere to high\-quality work standards.
* Responsible for maintaining Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability of Vehere’s information assets including business critical information.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electronics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in Firewall Support, Network Security, Technical Support, or Professional Services.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise firewall technologies and network security solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting skills involving routing, switching, VPNs, NAT, packet capture analysis, and security event investigation.
* Familiarity with Linux systems and command\-line troubleshooting is desirable.
* Working knowledge of SIEM, SOC operations, and incident response processes is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer\-facing abilities.
* Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Security, CEH, NSE, PCNSE, or equivalent are preferred.

title: Senior Specialist - Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Administrator
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Senior Specialist \- Power BI \& Microsoft Fabric Administrator
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32401**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Senior Specialist in this position should be a highly skilled Power BI \& Microsoft Fabric Administrator to support and advance our enterprise self service BI strategy. This role focuses heavily on platform and capacity administration, governance, security, and operational excellence within Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. A strong understanding of BI development concepts (datasets, semantic models, dataflows, pipelines) is required to effectively support business publishers and guide self service users. This position also includes limited support for our existing Tableau environment during transition, ensuring continuity while organizational reporting shifts toward Power BI and Fabric.

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?

* Along with strong understanding of BI development (Power BI datasets, dataflows, semantic models, pipelines)
* Experience with governance and enterprise BI support models
* You must excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills
* And the ability to work with distributed teams and support global users


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. description:

As a Senior Associate, you will utilize your skills to analyze complex problems, mentor others, and maintain professional standards. You will be responsible for building meaningful client connections and developing a deeper understanding of the business context.

Embracing technology and innovation, you will enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same, while continuously developing your personal brand and technical skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assisting clients in business transformations by leveraging SAP digital solutions to enhance internal controls and governance processes
* Conducting assessments of ERP security, business processes, and IT General Controls to identify potential risks and recommend improvements
* Leading walkthroughs with clients to evaluate business and IT processes, confirming compliance with regulatory standards
* Testing IT applications and automated controls within business processes such as Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, and Record to Report
* Reviewing and validating key reports to address risks related to Information Produced by Entity (IPE)
* Collaborating with engagement managers to scope and plan client engagements effectively
* Preparing detailed reports and deliverables for clients and stakeholders, highlighting key findings and recommendations
* Developing and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support business opportunities
* Coaching and mentoring junior team members to enhance their skills and knowledge in system transformation projects
* Managing project economics and confirming efficient resource allocation for engagement teams


 What You Must Have
   

  

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting, Management Information Systems or equivalent,
   

  

* At least 4\-7 years of experience
* Demonstrating, in addition to the minimum years of experience required for the role, experience in SAP/Oracle controls auditing, consulting and/or implementing, data analysis, compliance, internal audit, or risk.
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Possessing Chartered Accountant certification
* Holding certifications such as CISA, CISSP, or CISM
* Demonstrating experience with SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)
* Utilizing ERP System Integration skills
* Applying analytical thinking to complex business transformations
* Engaging in business process improvement initiatives
* Navigating SAP Supply Chain Management (SAP SCM) solutions

**Position Overview:**
 The Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – IT is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability and day\-to\-day support of IT infrastructure and end\-user systems across operational and administrative locations within the assigned region. The role coordinates IT support activities, manages vendor service delivery, resolves infrastructure issues and ensures minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, HR and Corporate IT teams, the role provides first and second\-level support for IT infrastructure, end\-user computing, hardware, software and network\-related issues while ensuring adherence to service levels, IT standards and information security requirements.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To provide reliable, responsive and efficient IT support across the assigned region by ensuring timely resolution of technology issues, effective vendor coordination, high system availability and uninterrupted business operations through proactive infrastructure support and adherence to IT governance standards.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Regional IT Operations Support**
* Provide day\-to\-day IT support across all operational and administrative locations within the assigned region, ensuring high system availability and minimal business disruption.
* Coordinate resolution of hardware, software, network and system\-related issues impacting business operations.
* Ensure operational locations receive timely IT support in accordance with defined service levels.
* Provide on\-site support for critical IT issues where remote resolution is not feasible.
* Support regional IT readiness for new branch openings, relocations, expansions and operational infrastructure changes.


**Incident \& Service Request Management**
* Manage IT incidents and service requests from logging through resolution, ensuring adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Prioritise and coordinate resolution of business\-critical incidents impacting operational continuity.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting and coordinate with specialised support teams for second and third\-level issues.
* Track recurring incidents, identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, escalation records and service request updates.


**End User Computing \& Infrastructure Support**
* Support end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, handheld devices, scanners and other operational IT equipment.
* Coordinate installation, configuration and maintenance of approved hardware, software and peripheral devices.
* Ensure timely provisioning and replacement of IT equipment for employees and operational locations.
* Support connectivity, user access, system availability and peripheral device functionality across the region.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance activities to maximise infrastructure reliability and equipment uptime.


**Vendor Management \& Service Delivery**
* Coordinate and monitor regional IT support vendors to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs and escalate service gaps where required.
* Validate completion of vendor activities and ensure quality of work performed.
* Coordinate warranty repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and third\-party support activities.
* Build effective working relationships with vendor partners to ensure uninterrupted IT support across the region.


**IT Asset \& Inventory Management**
